spatial.reservePerBin: up to 3 distinct fine subcells per occupied parent first, then remaining existing Regional capacity proportionally
spatial.rule: reserve up to three distinct real 3x3 fine subcells inside every occupied 6x6 terrain sector first, then distribute the remaining unchanged Regional capacity proportionally; science gates, water safety, final score ordering and capacity remain unchanged

fineRebalance16778.rule: count-neutral swaps replace duplicate chosen fine cells with real screened candidates in missing 18x18 cells; donor parent sectors retain at least three chosen corridors

fine.rule: count-neutral swaps replace duplicate chosen fine cells with real screened candidates in missing 18x18 cells; donor parent sectors retain at least three chosen corridors

coverage.densityRule: significant terrain sectors: preferred >=60 => 3 corridors; >=30 => 2; otherwise >=1; exact-cell high-resolution scientific null may explain a lower count

gap.rule: refine up to 18 exact jurisdiction cells; one tile transport failure cannot discard successful cells and is never mislabeled as a scientific null
